title: The sign-in gate, typed badly
persona: A careless typist on a small phone who has never used GreenFolio, trying to get in without reading anything.
goal: Try the sign-in form the way a careless person would: leave fields empty, type an email with no @, a very long email, a short password, tick and untick the terms box, and press Sign in each time. Open the Terms and Privacy links and come back. Do not create an account.
success: Every invalid attempt shows a clear message next to the right field, and the app is still on the sign-in screen with nothing broken.
